source.server_warning: The server does not recognize this client and will not allow hardcore unlocks. Please send a message to RAdmin on the RetroAchievements website for information on how to submit your emulator for hardcore consideration.
source.caveat: Achievement definitions are public RetroAchievements data. The memory addresses are PCSX2 addresses, NOT this recomp. See address_map.shift.

screens.note: From the game's OWN rich-presence patch: it names two of our screen states explicitly, which is where 0x01 and 0x04 got their names.

shift.NOT_uniform: Only 11 of the 403 distinct addresses sit in 0x6Axxxx and need the shift. The other 392 are already in 0x6Bxxxx -- where our own objects live -- so adding 0x4000 to those lands outside them.

per_character_table.note: 0x006B9658 + 16*k for k=0..7, plus a byte flag at +0 of the 5th entry. Eight 16-byte records is the shape of a per-character table, and it is the only family in the set with a regular stride. Best candidate for character-select data. UNVERIFIED: PCSX2 layout.

rich_presence_patch:
Lookup:Mode
0x0=Dragon History
0x1=Ultimate Battle
0x2=Dragon World Tour
0x3=Duel
0x4=
0x5=Evolution Z
0x6=Ultimate Training
0x7=Data Center
0x8=Character Reference
0x9=Options
0x0a=Shenron (Summoning a Dragon)

Lookup:Diff
0x0=Easy
0x1=Normal
0x2=Hard

Display:
?0xH006af198=1?On the Title Screen
?0xH006af198=4?On the Main Menu
?0xh6af1ac=1?Currently in Dragon History | Difficulty: @Diff(0xh6af1bc)
Currently playing around in: @Mode(0xh6af1ac)
